name: Bio Gasthof Post
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bio Gasthof Post in Mittenwald**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Bio Gasthof Post** invites you to experience authentic mountain hospitality in the charming village of **Mittenwald**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy, family-run inn combines rustic charm with modern comforts, all while embracing sustainable living.

Our **Bio** (organic) concept ensures that every meal is crafted with fresh, locally sourced ingredients—from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to savory **Tiroler Gröstl**. Savor traditional dishes with a modern twist, all prepared with care for both taste and the environment.

After a day of hiking in the **Karwendel** or skiing on the slopes of **Seefeld**, unwind in our cozy common room by the crackling fireplace. For those seeking adventure, we’re perfectly located for exploring the **Zugspitze**, **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, or the picturesque **Isar** River.

Whether you’re here for relaxation, outdoor adventures, or culinary delights, **Bio Gasthof Post** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of the Alps. **Willkommen!**
